inspection.default: Open Farm intelligence first: show current advisory slice, eligible/blocked work, plan/evidence divergence, unresolved-question queue and cross-blueprint comparison.

inspection.futurePhysical: Blueprints may appear as plans/folios/work orders in the 3D factory, but planned status must never look like running machinery.
